Pre-commissioning facility cleaning.basis: Per sf; final clean of entire building ($0.15-0.40) plus pits, trenches and equipment exteriors, tech-rate crew lead

Production line and machinery cleaning.basis: Per worker-hour; tech rate ~$55 with specialist on guarded equipment; analog data center post-construction cleaning detail work

Abrasive blasting residue cleanup.basis: Per sf of blast area; warehouse post-construction and ceiling dust removal analogs, HEPA/vacuum loader, higher end for lead-plan work

Semiconductor facility final cleaning.basis: Per sf; cleanroom protocol cleaning ($0.75-3.00) with added passes and gowning for fab classes

Pharmaceutical and biotechnology facilit.basis: Per sf; cleanroom protocol cleaning analog with documentation; general lab areas at low end

Battery energy storage facility cleaning.basis: Per container or enclosure; ~4 tech-hours at $55-70 dry HEPA work, data center post-construction analog

Solar installation construction cleanup.basis: Per crew-day (4 general cleaners x 8 hr at ~$42 plus truck); solar array cleaning and warehouse cleanup analogs

Renewable energy facility turnover clean.basis: Per sf of buildings; final clean of entire building plus remote mobilization, yards and pads

Airport and terminal construction cleani.basis: Per sf; final clean of entire building with night premium, escort and security screening time

Railway and transit station cleaning.basis: Per sf; final clean of entire building plus track-window and night work premiums

Cruise terminal construction cleanup.basis: Per sf; final clean of entire building plus glass and waterside containment

Parking garage construction cleanup.basis: Per sf of deck; parking garage floor scrubbing ($0.05-0.20) plus stair towers, lobbies and drains

EV charging facility construction cleani.basis: Per charger stall incl. pad and canopy; ~1 general/tech hour each, pressure washing and solar analogs

Transportation maintenance facility clea.basis: Per sf; warehouse post-construction cleaning plus pits, trench drains and offices

Marine and marina construction cleaning.basis: Per sf of dock and building; sidewalk pressure washing and final clean analogs with containment and no-discharge methods

Public infrastructure project cleaning.basis: Per sf; final clean of entire building and warehouse cleanup analogs, prevailing wage at high end
